plainText:
Volume 3: Saffron City Siege is the third volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the final volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Mato.

==Blurb==
Red is improving rapidly as a Pokémon trainer--and so is his competition. But now Red must team up with his biggest rival Blue and thief Green to defeat a common enemy!

And watch out for Team Rocket, Red... They won't let you into Saffron City!

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 28 - Peace of Mime
Chapter 29 - Go for the Golbat
Chapter 30 - Zap! Zap! Zapdos!
Chapter 31 - The Art of Articuno
Chapter 32 - A Little Kadabra'll Do It
Chapter 33 - The Winged Legends
Chapter 34 - And Mewtwo Too?!
Chapter 35 - And Mewtwo... Three!
Chapter 36 - Drat That Dratini!
Chapter 37 - Golly, Golem!
Chapter 38 - Long Live the Nidoqueen?!
Chapter 39 - Just a Spearow Carrier
Chapter 40 - A Charizard...and a Champion

==Important events==
 
Team Rocket disbands.
is given a Pokédex.
wins the 9th Pokémon League.

==Party changes==
===Additions=== 
The following Pokémon are obtained:
Yellow's "Ratty" in PS036.

===Evolutions===
The following Pokémon evolve:
Green's "Blasty" evolves into prior to PS030.
Red's "Saur" evolves into in PS033.

==Gym battles==
Red, Blue, and Green defeat the following Gym Leaders:
Lt. Surge in PS030 (Red)
Koga in PS031 (Blue)
Sabrina in PS033 (Green)
in PS038 (Red)

==Character summary==
This is Red's Pokédex information and party at the end of this volume.
===Red's Pokédex===
Gym Badges: 7
Pokémon seen: 132
Pokémon owned: 71

==Trivia==
===Errors===
====VIZ Media first edition====
In Just a Spearow Carrier, when the Pokémon League scoreboard is shown, Red's rival is identified as "GREEN" and Green is identified as "BLUE". This error is a result of and switching names for the English translation. This error was also present in the compilation volume The Best of Pokémon Adventures: Red.

====VIZ Media second edition====
On the recap page, is listed as the Gym Leader of "Cinnabar Town" rather than Cinnabar Island.
On page 5, Blue's Charizard is wrongly called .
On page 23, erroneously refers to Lavender Town as "Lavender City," and on page 27, says "Pikachu... read?!" instead of "ready".
The "next volume preview" page uses cover artwork for volume four that does not match the cover artwork used for the final version.
As the same with the previous book, at the back of the book, where it shows Red's party, it nicknames "Snor" as "Lax".

===Translation edits===
In the VIZ Media second edition printing, the scene in A Little Kadabra'll Do It where hides s in her top is edited out. The dialog is changed to make the edited scene make sense.
